description: Architecture diagram of the Intel-Red Hat AI Inference Platform. Shows the dual-path routing from a single gateway to three inference lanes: Eco (Granite on Xeon 6), Performance (CodeLlama on Xeon 6), and Overdrive (Llama Scout on Gaudi). Includes PostgreSQL database, React frontend, and LiteLLM proxy.
visual_elements: Gateway box (center top) with routing arrows
Eco lane (green, left) — Granite Tiny, Xeon 6
Performance lane (blue, center) — CodeLlama 7B, Xeon 6 + AMX
Overdrive lane (orange, right) — Llama Scout 17B, Gaudi
demo_context: The canonical architecture diagram for the platform — used in the Architecture Explainer workload profile.
